THE CORPORATION OF THE CITY OF GRAND FORKS BYLAW NO. 1958-A19
A BYLAW TO AMEND THE CITY OF GRAND FORKS FEES AND CHARGES BYLAW NO. 1958
The Council of the Corporation of the City of Grand Forks enacts as follows: 1. This bylaw may be cited as the “City of Grand Forks Fees and Charges Amendment Bylaw
No. 1958-A19”.
2. That “Fees and Charges Bylaw No. 1958, 2014” be amended as follows:
a) Replace “Schedule G – Electrical Utility Fees and Charges” with the attached “Schedule G – Electrical Utility Fees and Charges” in Appendix 1 of this bylaw.
c) Replace “Schedule J – Water Service Charges” with the attached “Schedule J – Water Service Charges” in Appendix 1 of this bylaw.
d) Replace “Schedule K – Sewer Service Charges” with the attached “Schedule K – Sewer Service Charges” in Appendix 1 of this bylaw.
3. The effective date of this amending bylaw shall be April 15, 2026.
Read a first, second and third time this 23rd day of March, 2026.
Finally adopted this 13th day of April, 2026.
________________________ ____________________________
Mayor Everett Baker Corporate Officer Kevin McKinnon
CERTIFICATE I hereby certify the foregoing to be a true copy of Bylaw No. 1958-A19, as passed by the
Municipal Council of the City of Grand Forks on this 13th day of April, 2026.
______________________________________
Corporate Officer of the Municipal Council
of the City of Grand Forks
